text.description_html:
Schlage FB50LAT, Keyed Alike Latitude Lever and Deadbolt

The Modern Latitude Lever with Deadbolt Combo Pack is packaged as a set with a keyed entry function door lever and a single cylinder deadbolt. Both the lever and the deadbolt use the same key. This is a great way to add security to your front door. The Latitude Door Lever with Single Cylinder Deadbolt will fit most pre-drilled doors. Its modern design makes it great for home remodels.

Combo Set Function: The lever is unlocked by a key from the outside when locked by inside turn button. Inside always unlocked. The deadbolt thrown or retracted with a key from the outside and by turn unit on the inside. Bolt automatically deadlocks when fully thrown.

Features of the Schlage Latitude Door Lever with Single Cylinder Deadbolt:

  • Interior Deadbolt Thumb Turn Meets ADA Requirements
  • ANSI/BHMA A156.2 Grade 3 Security
  • 1" deadbolt throw.
  • Sold as complete set.
  • Fits most pre-drilled doors.
  • 5-pin tumbler C keyway.
  • Easy to install.
  • Reversible handing.
  • Lifetime Finish Warranty.
  • Lifetime Mechanical Warranty.

Features for the B-Series Deadbolt Combo Pack with Latitude Lever:

  • Lever Length: 4.4375"
  • Lever Rose Diameter: 2-3/4"
  • Lever Projection: 2.375"
  • Deadbolt Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/8" up to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Round Corner Full Lip Strike and 1-1/8" x 2-3/4" Deadbolt Strike

Both locks (door lever lock and deadbolt lock) are keyed alike (use the same key). If ordering more than 1 lock set you can have each set Keyed Different or Keyed Alike.
